objective: Computation: after the frozen run of ticket A (R2 works at rounds 10 to 14 and fails from round 15, where the pairwise prune loses a known junction and sums of three small junctions near the seed make spurious ones), a reader R3 that keeps earlier junctions and prunes sums of up to three known junctions, frozen before it runs, scored at rounds 10 to 20.
title: An incremental reader
